messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer while noting available capacity—it sounds like this project offers you more than an individual order. We value that relationship, recognise the strain our late payments have caused, and will ensure reliable, on-time payment. If we accelerate payment, how much could you sharpen your price, also taking the verified reductions in material and energy indices into account?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.44 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, you did your homework on the material index, and getting paid in 14 days is exactly what we need right now. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? I can come down to €30.00 per piece if we lock in those 14 days and the volume you mentioned. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our present Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.44 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

You emphasise long-term partnership, and your earlier note links additional capacity to firm commitment—it sounds like predictable demand is central to making this work for you. Our binding commitment provides that certainty, and we want its planning value reflected in competitive pricing. How can you translate that certainty into a sharper price while ensuring dependable delivery?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 26.57 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Hi guys, thanks for the volume confirmation, that's great! We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot is a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I looked at those indexes you sent, and yeah they dropped a bit, but nowhere near enough for that kind of price cut. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

As an alternative, I can drop the price to €31.00 per unit with your 30 days payment, but we have to trade that for 52 days lead time, as our order book is super full right now despite the frame contract. So that package is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
